CANDIDATE.label: EQ_SEC_STAFF_COMMENT_LETTER_SCRUTINY
CANDIDATE.economic_mechanism: When the SEC's Division of Corporation Finance sends a filer a comment letter, a government reviewer has formally objected to that filer's accounting, disclosure or revenue recognition. The objection is made and resolved PRIVATELY, and only then disseminated on EDGAR as form UPLOAD (the staff letter) with the filer's reply as CORRESP. The predicted-return object is the arrival of an ADVERSE THIRD-PARTY ASSESSMENT OF REPORTING QUALITY that the issuer did not choose to publish and cannot time. It is slow-diffusing because it is unstructured text with no numeric field, no vendor summary and no analyst coverage. The signal is the EVENT ITSELF plus its intensity (letter count, and whether the exchange escalates to a second round), NOT a state variable modulating a premium.

The panel supplies RETURNS ONLY.

THE_THREE_WAY_CLASSIFICATION_THE_TASK_DE.a_duplicate_source: YES, ADMITTED. The publisher is SEC EDGAR and EDGAR carries six settled information families in this estate (P4, P5, P6, P8, P11 above). This cell is a duplicate SOURCE and the spec says so first, before its novelty claim.
THE_THREE_WAY_CLASSIFICATION_THE_TASK_DE.b_duplicate_economic_mechanism: NO, AND THE EVIDENCE IS A FILE AND A LINE, NOT AN ASSERTION. Every settled EDGAR mechanism reads an object the ISSUER produced and timed: SEC_FILING_BEHAVIOUR_R27 (the issuer's filing cadence), DISCLOSURE_INTENSITY_R63 and R58_DISCLOSURE_INTENSITY_V1 (how much the issuer discloses), EVENT_8K_ITEM_CODES (the issuer's chosen 8-K item), PIT_FUNDAMENTALS_AND_VALUATION (the issuer's XBRL numbers), INSIDER_FORM4_ALL / OWNERSHIP_BREADTH_13F / CONTROL_BLOCK_13DG (holder filings). A comment letter is authored by the SEC ABOUT the issuer, is adversarial, is timed by the regulator, and has no numeric field. Different author, different intent, different timing control, different economic content.
THE_THREE_WAY_CLASSIFICATION_THE_TASK_DE.c_genuinely_new_information_channel: YES, AND IT IS VERIFIABLE AT THE BYTE LEVEL RATHER THAN BY ARGUMENT. configs/alpha_agent/stage2_ingestion.json line 118 sets forms_of_interest = ["8-K","8-K/A","10-Q","10-Q/A","10-K","10-K/A","4","4/A"]. UPLOAD and CORRESP are absent. A repo-wide grep for the tokens UPLOAD and CORRESP across every .py file returns two files, alpha_agent/r40/contract.py:171 and alpha_agent/r40/open_models.py:6,271, and both are the unrelated constant NO_RESTRICTED_DATA_UPLOAD. The estate has never read one byte of this form type.
THE_THREE_WAY_CLASSIFICATION_THE_TASK_DE.why_this_is_NOT_the_R67_TERMS_OF_TRADE_O: R67's V2 ruling refused XA_TERMS_OF_TRADE because the feature was 'built entirely from returns' - the same INPUT BYTES already prosecuted, relabelled into an unused information_family slot to reach a burden-0 key. That test is decisive here and it acquits this cell: the input bytes are a form type never collected and not derivable from any prosecuted input. The director applied R67's test rather than avoiding it.

REOPEN_CONDITION_COMPLIANCE_UNDER_THE_MO.the_adversarial_reading: An adversary says: strip the story away and this is drift after a document appears on EDGAR, which is POST_FILING_DRIFT|FILING_EVENT|US_EQUITY, SETTLED_DO_NOT_REPEAT (P3, P4).
REOPEN_CONDITION_COMPLIANCE_UNDER_THE_MO.the_director_does_not_dismiss_it: The recorded reopen condition on both P3 and P4 is NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION, and the census rule requires the claim to be stated in the hypothesis text. It is stated below, and the director rules the condition SATISFIED on the byte-level evidence in section (c): a form type never ingested is new information in the only sense the condition can mean.
REOPEN_CONDITION_COMPLIANCE_UNDER_THE_MO.the_burden_consequence_the_director_acce: Because the conservative reading is arguable, this cell must NOT be charged to a fresh burden-0 key. Its multiple-testing denominator is declared below as the UNION of the FILING_EVENT and POST_FILING_DRIFT rows plus this cell, not 1. That is the R68 correction's 'budget it as what it is' discipline applied against the director's own proposal.

PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE.the_instant_the_information_becomes_obse: The EDGAR full-index 'Date Filed' of the UPLOAD row is the date the SEC DISSEMINATED the letter to the public. Comment letters are released no earlier than 20 business days after the staff declares the review complete, so the private correspondence date is strictly earlier than and is NOT used. Date Filed is the first public instant.
PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE.the_lag_actually_applied: SIGNAL_LAG_SESSIONS = 1. An event with Date Filed d enters the signal set from the FIRST SESSION STRICTLY AFTER d. Entry is at the next session's close on the panel's total-return series. Intraday acceptance timestamps are available on EDGAR but are deliberately NOT used: a same-day rule would require an intraday mark this campaign does not own, and R60 already settled that a next-session rule is the honest one here.
PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE.how_it_will_be_certified: D1 must (i) confirm Date Filed is the dissemination date and not the correspondence date, by pulling the header of at least 50 sampled UPLOAD documents and comparing their internal letter date to the index Date Filed, and (ii) confirm no row in the materialised event table has an availability instant earlier than its Date Filed close.
PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE.leakage_check_owner: alpha_agent.agents_v2.leakage, run by the feature-library-agent before publication; the campaign does not self-certify.

cost_model.net_cost_budget_rather_than_a_turnover_c: The R60 census records that the scalar 0.40 one-way turnover ceiling is two different economic constraints misspecified as one, and that it destroyed two of four non-equity cells before any return was scored. BOUNDED_TEST_PRE_DECLARED.primary_statistic: Newey-West t-statistic on the mean net excess return of the long-short book at the LOCKBOX stage, computed by alpha_agent.r57.engine through alpha_agent.r59.engines.gate. ONE statistic. No IC, no Sharpe, no hit rate is promoted to a decision role.
BOUNDED_TEST_PRE_DECLARED.pre_declared_threshold: |t| >= 3.00 at lockbox, with the sign equal to the expected sign, AFTER the Benjamini-Hochberg correction the gate applies at the declared burden denominator. Borderline is a fail. 2.99 is a fail.

multiple_testing_burden_it_carries.how_it_is_built: 1 (this cell) + 2 (the FILING_EVENT rows returned by probe P4) + 1 (the POST_FILING_DRIFT row returned by probe P3, deduplicated against P4's overlap and counted once). The director declares 4 rather than 1 because the conservative reading of this cell is a FILING_EVENT reopen and, per the R68 correction, a reopened mechanism inherits its parent's denominator and may never be charged to a fresh key.
multiple_testing_burden_it_carries.authoritative_owner: alpha_agent.r59.handlers.search_denominator computes the binding number at registration time. If it returns a LARGER denominator than 4, the larger number governs. If it returns a SMALLER one, 4 still governs, because a director may raise his own burden and may not lower it.

DECLARED_FAILURE_CONDITIONS_SO_A_NULL_IS: F1 SUBSTRATE. D1 returns NOT_CERTIFIABLE on any of its frozen kill conditions -> the cell is never pre-registered, the campaign returns NULL_ON_DATA, and that is a durable fact about the estate, exactly as R73_D1 and R75_D1 are.

F2 POWER. Fewer than 400 name-events with a bridged, in-universe, in-sample decision -> HALT BEFORE MEASUREMENT as UNDERPOWERED. The R60 census records that FUT_BASIS_MOMENTUM_COMMODITY was annotated UNDERPOWERED rather than dead, and that the annotation was the honest call; the same standard binds here and an underpowered null must NOT be reported as evidence of absence.
F3 COST. The 3.00%/yr net cost budget is breached -> HALT BEFORE MEASUREMENT.
F4 STATISTIC. |t| < 3.00 at lockbox, or the sign is wrong at any stage -> NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE. A wrong sign is a kill, never a re-specification.
F5 ADVERSARIAL. The placebo pack produces a comparable statistic on shuffled event dates -> NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE regardless of the primary statistic.

F6 COVERAGE DRIFT. The 2026Q2 UPLOAD-count anomaly turns out to be a real, unexplained collapse in coverage rather than a reporting artefact -> the out-of-sample stage is not credible and the cell HALTS.

measurement.naive_hit_interpretation: A naive hit is the base ticker of a DELISTED name appearing in today's SEC map, which is overwhelmingly TICKER RECYCLING by a different issuer. It is reported to size the hazard and is explicitly NOT usable as a bridge. Using those 288 would inject 288 wrong-issuer joins into the event table.

BLOCKING_DEFECT.why_this_blocks_rather_than_merely_degra: sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json maps CIK to the CURRENT ticker of a CURRENTLY-registered filer. It has no history and no dead registrants. A comment-letter book built on it can only see events on names that still exist in 2026. Comment letters concentrate on filers with contested accounting; filers with contested accounting delist at an elevated rate. So the unobservable 65.2% is selected in exactly the direction of the hypothesis, and a measured underperformance would be understated while a measured null would be uninformative. This is the same failure shape the R60 census used to freeze us_equity_extension_pit_panel_v1, and the director is applying that precedent to his own proposal rather than only to someone else's.
BLOCKING_DEFECT.what_would_clear_it: A CIK-to-panel-symbol bridge with measured coverage of DELISTED names and a measured false-match rate against a permanent identifier. See ACQUISITION_PROPOSAL in DIRECTOR_R76_RULING.json.
what_will_NOT_clear_it: Restricting the universe to the 661 currently-listed names. That is not a mitigation, it IS the defect, written into the universe definition.

Name-based fuzzy matching against sec.gov/Archives/edgar/cik-lookup-data.txt without a measured false-match rate and a pre-declared threshold - that is precisely the unaudited issuer-name bridge the R60 census records as the reason the extension panel is frozen.
